text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A true princess! Brilliant, graceful, and 
valiant! Blazing Fierce Princess☆Princess 
Fighter!!

While walking through the academy, I ran 
into Kawakami Princess and the others 
filming a video.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We're filming for the official PreFie 
project, the 'PreFie Iconic Scene 
Reenactment Video Contest'!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I invited everyone whom I felt a 
"Princess's soul" from, and they've 
graciously offered their help!

"Everyone" meant the Umamusume present 
here. It seemed Kawakami Princess saw 
potential princess qualities in them and 
asked for their help.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is it! Trainer, could you be our 
cameraman? All of us will be in the next 
scene!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now then, moving on to the scene from the 
original PreFie movie where 'the Princess 
streaks through satellite orbit guided by 
the light cast by the Prince'~~!

text_block_list.name: Darkness Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Give it up already! 
Princess☆Fighter!

text_block_list.name: Darkness Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Your opponent is... 10, 100, 1000...? 
Wait, my bad! An army of one billion dark 
Umamusume~~!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Princess, run toward my light. Now, recite 
the PriFai Running Style Spell. ...Huh? 
The line is 'running style', right?

text_block_list.name: Prifight
text_block_list.text:
B... Burning fighting spirit, heart struck 
by love♪ An explosive dashing sprinter☆ So 
perky... and so fi-fi...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Cut!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This is a quintessential 
handkerchief-mandatory scene! I know all 
of you can unleash even more emotion than 
that!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? This is supposed to be a tearjerker 
scene!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Not only turning the tables from 
complete despair when surrounded by the 
Dark Umamusume, but the conversation with 
the Prince right before was foreshadowing 
that got my heart pounding so hard—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's intense...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And so, let's take it from the top! Ready, 
ACTIOOOON!!!!

text_block_list.name: Darkness Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Give it up! 
Princess☆Fighteeer~~!!

And with that, the shoot progressed, 
leading up to the final dance scene with 
everyone—

text_block_list.name: Prifight Season 3 ED
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ Rip and tear at full power♪ Make way 
for the warrior princess♪

text_block_list.name: Prifight Season 3 ED
text_block_list.text: Everyone gather under the tiara♪

text_block_list.name: Prifight Season 3 ED
text_block_list.text: Full of pep, Princess♪ Hoo-ah!
choice_data_list:
Alright! Let's play back what we just 
recorded!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~~, this feels great! Doesn't it, 
Kawakami-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Not enough.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer! We are re-filming my part alone!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"There are soooo... sooo many things I 
want to tell PreFie!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
How cool they look when racing!! 
Understanding how it feels to mess up!! I 
wanna cram ALLLL of it into the video!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I want to go all the way until I'm 
completely satisfied!!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Because I refuse to compromise on what I 
love!!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. When you really love something, 
you can't just give up on it no matter 
what!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Hearing that, there's no way we can 
just settle for "good enough" with our 
dance!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Playing PriFigh is so much fun! I can keep 
going strong~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A first-rate Umamusume is starring in 
this. So we must make the video quality 
first-rate as well!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Everyone...!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let us begin!! Ready, and 
action~~~~!!!!

And so, Kawakami Princess and the others 
completed a video they were satisfied 
with. And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, it is about to begin! The contest 
results will be announced after the 
commercial! The grand prize winner is—

text_block_list.name: Prifight
text_block_list.text:
"To Kawakami Princess and everyone at 
Tracen Academy! Thank you so much for the 
super spirited video~~!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
G-Grand... Prize...! PreFai is giving 
thanks... to me...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hoeaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-chan?! Kawakami-chan!! ...Gasp, 
she passed out...!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Still, she looks so completely happy...

Kawakami Princess and the others united as 
one and completed the video. And a few 
days later—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The contest results are in~~!! Believe it 
or not, I won the Grand Prize!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wah!! You did it, Kawakami-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The prize is invitation tickets to the 
PreFy show! After the show, there's even a 
handshake event with PreFy~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Waaah!! That sounds so fun!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Of course, everyone join in! Let's cheer 
on PreFie live together~~!!

Though utterly exhausted, Kawakami 
Princess and the others managed to finish 
the video. And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I heard the news, Kawakami! Our video won 
first place, didn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! What's more, on the show, Pre-Fi 
thanked me personally!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It feels so much like a dream, like a 
total dream...!! ...Fuheeeaaeeeee~~~~~~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What's wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Just thinking about it made my face 
completely melt into a smile~~~..."
